title: Understanding Anodizing and Chem Film Surface Finishes
summary: Anodizing and chem-film surface conversion processes convert a workpiece’s surface in preparation for secondary coating processes. The workpiece’s surface finishes before conversion coating will affect the quality of finish of the conversion coating.
